title: Trump keeps door open to call with Taiwan's president even though China has warned against it
description: WASHINGTON, Jun 6: President Donald Trump has indicated that he may still speak with Taiwan’s President Lai Ching-te, even after China has publicly urged him not to directly engage with the leader of the self-ruled island that Beijing claims as its own. Trump first raised the idea last month on his way back from meeting President Xi Jinping in Beijing, saying that he intended to speak directly with Lai as he weighs whether to go ahead with a USD 14 […]

title: China steps up patrols near Taiwan
description: China has launched a special maritime operation east of Taiwan. This action escalates Beijing's response to recent talks between Japan and the Philippines on maritime borders. The negotiations concern waters east of Taiwan, which China claims. China states the operation aims to assert its jurisdiction and protect national interests. This move follows previous Chinese patrols in the area.

title: Taiwan Official Rejects Fears Trump Could ‘Trade’ Island to China
description: Taiwan's representative to the U.S. said the $14 billion arms package reflects the island's growing security threats.

title: Taiwan says Chinese coast guard, research ships near key S. China Sea islands
description: Taiwan accuses China of coordinated provocations near the Pratas Islands, heightening tensions in the strategically vital South China Sea.

title: China escalates patrols near Taiwan over Japan-Philippines talks
description: Chinese Ministry of Transport organized a “special maritime traffic enforcement operation” on Saturday

title: India to account for half of global oil demand growth over next decade: Rosneft CEO
description: Rosneft CEO Igor Sechin stated India will drive nearly half of global oil demand growth over the next decade, projecting consumption to reach eight million barrels per day by 2035. He highlighted Russian oil supplies' economic benefits to India and China, exceeding $40 billion since April 2022, and warned of food price hikes due to potential Strait of Hormuz disruptions.

title: China Escalates Patrols Near Taiwan Over Japan-Philippines Talks
description: China said it launched a special maritime operation east of Taiwan, ramping up its response to a recent agreement between Japan and the Philippines to negotiate maritime borders in the area and deepen defense cooperation.

title: Rosneft assures stable Russian oil supplies to India amid West Asia war
description: Rosneft chief Igor Sechin has said that Russia's energy partnership with India and China will ensure steady crude supplies despite disruptions from the West Asia conflict and the Strait of Hormuz blockade.

title: Taipei Zoo welcomes a pair of red pandas from China, first in over a decade

title: Taiwan's Bold Stance: Condemning Beijing's Interference in Global Relations
description: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan has condemned Beijing's alleged interference in President William Lai's planned visit to Eswatini. The resolution accuses China of leveraging economic pressure on African nations to block Lai's trip, highlighting ongoing tensions and Taiwan's commitment to defending its sovereignty and international standing.
